trigger.knowledge_state: S11 FAIL was known before this amendment; every change below is a disclosed post-failure repair

diagnosis.scope: two repeatable RO-ctl runs only; never R-S

H1_unknown_before_suppression.observation: ticks 21-28 are scored and alarming in both runs

H2_local_not_subset_of_zone.observation: while inject is active, link-s2-s3 is outside the stored radius at tick 21 and link-s1-s3 plus link-s2-s3 are outside from tick 22
H2_local_not_subset_of_zone.mechanism: the stored radius follows frozen pre-action routes through s1-s2 and omits the physical detour corridor s1-s3-s2

diagnosis.determinism: same status, outside-zone links, act entry, and zero suppression in seeds 4301 and 4302

point_not_interval.mechanism: active_at covers only [t_start,t_start+cooldown); admin_down remains applied for about 20 s
point_not_interval.why_not_raise_cooldown: cooldown describes post-action transient; raising it would create an overlong blind window and threaten S1/S4

pre_action_radius_omits_detour.mechanism: strict local subset radius is retained, but the radius lacks the shortest alternate switch path after removing the administered link
pre_action_radius_omits_detour.why_not_use_intersection: suppressing when any one entity intersects the zone could hide independent out-of-zone evidence
pre_action_radius_omits_detour.why_not_whole_network: whole-network suppression would mask unrelated faults beyond the causally affected corridor

planned_changes.ml/intervention_log.py: pair inject/revert as an interval; open intervals use MAX_OPEN_S=120 lease and stale_open exposes expiry
planned_changes.ml/blast_radius.py: add deterministic detour radius for link-state interventions: remove target switch edge, find shortest alternate switch path, union its switches and links with the existing radius
planned_changes.ml/rcampaign_runtime.py: record detour-aware radius for future admin_down interventions
planned_changes.ml/fsm.py: expose stale_intervention after a lease expires; do not reorder unknown handling because H1 was falsified
planned_changes.scripts/replay_phase6r_stability.py: for v2 only, reconstruct amended admin_down radius from sealed targets after verifying routing SHA; preserve v1 receipt

unchanged.subset_rule: all local violating entities must remain within the amended causal radius

new_risks.masking: a real independent fault on the declared intervention/detour corridor during the interval can be masked; document in model card v2
new_risks.stale_lease: if revert is never recorded, suppression stops at MAX_OPEN_S and stale_intervention is exposed; fail noisy rather than silently blind
new_risks.historical_radius_reconstruction: v2 replay uses a disclosed amended policy on the same repeatable RO-ctl snapshots; original sidecars and v1 receipt remain immutable

remeasurement_policy.allowed: yes; S11 is a deterministic proposition on R-O repeatable=true

write phase6r_replay_o3_v2.json and identify it as measurement two
commit this amendment before changing runtime code
